verdict.rationale: The docs say a named Bot keeps its memory and preferences across sessions instead of resetting. Setup consists of describing the job to the Bot, and Bots can be duplicated or shared as templates. Community users confirm that each bot owns its own context and that memory feels seamless. However, there is no documented custom-instructions field or account-wide setting that shapes every response; preferences appear to be per-Bot and learned through conversation. Missing for 10: an explicit, editable custom-instructions or system-prompt setting, global preferences applied across all Bots, and documentation of how stored preferences are viewed or edited.
